Change flat forms to fillable (Acrobat Pro)
You can change a flat form to a fillable form by either using the Prepare Form tool or
enabling the Fill & Sign tools. Acrobat and Acrobat Reader users can use the Fill & Sign tool
to fill in flat forms. Interactive form
To create an interactive form, use the Prepare Forms tool.

Fill in PDF Forms
Is the form fillable? Not all forms are fillable. Sometimes form creators don’t convert their PDFs to
interactive fillable forms.

For a list and explanation of each warning, see the DigSig Admin Guide. XML data signatures
Acrobat and Acrobat Reader support XML data signatures that are used to sign data in XML
Forms Architectures (XFA) forms. The form author provides XML signing, validating, or
clearing instructions for form events, such as button click, file save, or submit.
